# University of Virginia School of Education

> > A federally-funded special education coaching initiative supporting educators and students through evidence-based instructional practices.

The Coached program is a U.S. Department of Education-funded initiative housed at the University of Virginia's School of Education. It provides specialized coaching and resources to support special education professionals in implementing effective teaching strategies.
